programmes.description: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….
programmes.title: Stolen Treasures

programmes.description: William Blake (1757-1827) developed his own complex and personal mythology. He was a pre-romantic British painter, engraver and poet.
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: This gallery was built in the 16th century as the seat for Florence’s new administrative offices (uffizi), and opened to the public as the Uffizi Gallery in the 18th century. Today it still offers the world’s most beautiful collection of Italian Renaissance art. How could anyone remain insensitive to the sensual beauty of “The Birth of Venus” by Botticelli, “The Venus of Urbino” by Titian, or Correggio’s “Danae”?  Enjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Vauban's "queen of citadels" is the model for the military constructions that dot France. The Lille Citadelle was built between 1668 and 1671 at the request of Louis XIV, to designs by military engineer and architect Sébastien Le Prestre de Vauban. He conceived his fortress as a response to changes in the art of warfare. Although it has lost its original function, its rigor and formal simplicity have made it a source of inspiration for great contemporary architects.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: In this episode, we will meet the artist Richard Orlinski. In 2004, this artist decided to devote himself entirely to art. Imbued with pop-culture, the artist created a colorful universe, inspired by the wildest animals and iconic objects that marked their generation.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description:
It’s a journey into antiquity with glamorous historians Suzannah Lipscomb and Kate Williams. Paired with experts David Harper and Catherine Southon they Road Trip from Bletchley in Buckinghamshire to an auction in London.  

There’s also opportunity to hear how Mrs Beeton became the first ‘domestic Goddess’ and why Luton played a critical role in the fashion world when hats were de rigueur daily wear. 

David and Suzannah gamble on a giant ant while Catherine and Kate plump for a very large tea urn.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Two photographers compete on a given theme. Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, will then have to decide between them and choose the best of the two. Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.
programmes.title: Photo Contest

programmes.description: The Domaine de Kerguéhennec offers artists the opportunity to take a look at the nature of Morbihan in the heart of Brittany in a residency. In this episode, we will meet two artists who came to take part in the exercise and who will be able to create their works inspired by their impressions in the garden of the domain.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Georges Seurat. You will discover his labour with « Ile de France » landscape, Study for « a Sunday afternoon at the grande jatte », Study for « La grande jatte ».
programmes.title: An hour with...

programmes.description: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Jean-François Millet. You will discover his labour with Naked woman sleeping, Two bathers or The church at gréville.
programmes.title: An hour with...

programmes.description: Vincent van Gogh's life remains shrouded in mystery: madness, illness, suicide - all the ingredients to create a myth. With complete and unprecedented access to the treasures of Amsterdam's Van Gogh Museum, this documentary sheds light on both one of the world's favorite artists and the museum's rich and unique collection. Discover these marvelous masterpieces on the big screen, while guests including world-renowned curators and art historians offer their interpretations and explanations of Van Gogh's work.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Michelangelo Merisi (1571-1610), born in Caravaggio, is known as a wicked artist who had to flee Rome in 1606 after killing a man. But Caravaggio is above all a painter who changed the face of painting at the very beginning of the 17th century. Notice his use of colour in the people emerging from a dark background, like his “Bacchus” or “David”. One of his masterpieces is the cycle of the “Calling of Saint Matthew” in the chapel of the church of St- Louis-of-the-French in Rome.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!
programmes.title: Art quiz

programmes.description: My little Museum is Art History retold through funny anecdotes and backstage trivias by Alicia Flipo. With her wacky demeanor, her inventiveness and her quirky sense of humor, Alicia stages these small Art tales so that once and for all, you could remember the Big stories!
programmes.title: My little Museum

programmes.description: Jean Prouvé dreamed of creating homes as beautiful and rational as airplanes or automobiles. In 1953, at a time when he was going through the worst crisis of his life, he built his own house. Created in a hurry, out of bricks and mortar, it embodied his most innovative ideas. In a France where concrete was king, Prouvé was a man of metal, first folded sheet metal, then aluminum. From the 1930s onwards, he tried to rationalize the design of his buildings, dreaming of a housing industry that would build houses with the same precision with which cars and planes are built. This is what he calls "putting architecture back where it belongs". He is designing several models of low-cost, do-it-yourself kit homes, ready for mass production. Intelligent, functional and necessarily beautiful. The house he built for himself and his family in the heights of Nancy in the space of a few weeks in the summer of 1953, under dramatic circumstances, is a particularly moving embodiment of the designs and.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: The building constructed in Berlin by Daniel Libeskind raises the question of architecture's own limits: How to build where everything has been destroyed without erasing the traces of what has disappeared? Today, this museum is one of the largest in Europe and offers a testament to two millennia of Jewish history in Germany. More than a museum, it is a tribute to the millions of victims of the Holocaust.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: In this documentary, we take you on a tour of the world's first custom motorcycle exhibit. In the new and prestigious Peterson Museum in Los Angeles, the charismatic Paul d'Orleans, motorcycle historian, consultant for Bonham's and Sotheby's, gives us a private tour of the exhibition he curated. It is an exhibition where each motorcycle is unique and considered a work of art.
programmes.title: Custom Revolution

programmes.description: Digital arts have been evolving very quickly since the 60’s. Immersive, generative, participatory, 3D, augmented reality... digital arts embrace multiple forms. This documentary will try to define its contours to answer the question : Digital arts, an evolution or a revolution ?\r\nDigital art has no boundaries and intends to play with our perception of reality. From Biennale Nemo to the School of fine arts, from galleries to museum, we have traveled the roads of reality to explore its borders. Meet the experts to discover an up-and-coming art where humans interact with technological performances.\r\nWho are these new artists? How is this art welcomed in our societies? And how does it revolutionize our approach and our perception of art?
programmes.title: Digital Arts: (R)evolution?

programmes.description: After a two-year touring exhibition, in 2015 Girl with a Pearl Earring returned to the Mauritshuis Museum in The Hague. At 350 years old, the eternal Girl has always retained her aura of mystery and charm. The proof is in the number of curious onlookers (1.2 million) who flocked to catch a glimpse of her during her stay in Japan. The documentary seeks to uncover the many enigmas surrounding this extraordinary painting and its mysterious creator - Vermeer. Who was this girl? Why and how did Vermeer paint this picture? Come and travel back in time to discover Johannes Vermeer, visit the charming museum in The Hague and answer all these questions.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.\r\nWhat led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London.  \r\nJennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.\r\nAnd, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: This famous art gallery in Berlin holds one of the world’s leading collections of European works by Old Masters. Here you can find “The Fountain of Youth” by Cranach the Elder, or the earthy “Netherlandish Proverbs” illustrated by Bruegel. Allow yourself to be tempted by the sensuality of Correggio (“Leda and the Swan”) or of Titian (“Venus with Organist”), by the poetry of “The Glass of Wine”, a genre painting by Vermeer, or by the gracious “Iris or the Dance” by Watteau.  Enjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Multi-award-winning director Phil Grabsky takes a fresh look at arguably the world's most beloved artist, using the words of the painter himself. I, Claude Monet reveals new facets of the man who gave birth to the Impressionist movement with one painting, and who was certainly one of the most influential and renowned painters of the 19th and early 20th centuries. Shot on location across Europe, I, Claude Monet is an unprecedented, intimate film exploration of some of Western art's most beloved cult settings.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Every Rembrandt exhibition is eagerly awaited, but this exhibition organized by London's National Gallery and Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum was an unprecedented event. The documentary highlights the historic Rembrandt exhibition, while tracing his life. Rembrandt is one of the greatest artists who ever lived, and this deeply moving documentary seeks to explore the truth about the man behind the legend.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: This eagerly-awaited exhibition at the Royal Academy of Arts was the first-ever retrospective devoted to the portraiture of Édouard Manet. Covering the entire career of this enigmatic and sometimes controversial artist, the exhibition brought together works from Europe, Asia and the United States. Manet's portraiture has never been the subject of an exhibition, although it represents around half of his artistic output. He painted his family, friends and the literary, political and artistic figures of the day, bringing to life not only his subjects but also Parisian society.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Graffiti World is a short program dedicated to contemporary urban art around the world. Each episode explores a specific city, highlighting iconic works of street art. Local soundscape accompanies the images for an authentic, commentary-free immersion. The program showcases the creativity and diversity of artistic expression in public spaces. An invitation to discover the richness of graffiti as an art form in its own right.
programmes.title: Graffiti World

programmes.description: Passionate about horticulture, Monet remains the undisputed master of garden painting in the history of art, but he was not alone. Artists such as Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso and Matisse used the garden as a strong theme in their work. These great artists, along with many other famous names, are brought together in an innovative exhibition from the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Royal Gallery of Arts in London. From the exhibition itself to the beauty of artists' gardens such as Monet's at Giverny, we take a journey to discover how the modern garden was used to explore radical and wondrous new ideas.
programmes.title: Exhibition on Screen

programmes.description: Two luvvies from the world of stage and TV, Ruth Madoc and Su Pollard, best known for their appearances in sitcom Hi-De-Hi, are antique hunting with Phil Serrell and Raj Bisram. Setting off from the Welsh border town of Monmouth they head for auction in Congleton, Cheshire. \r\nRuth also gets to find out about the incredible 19th century nurse – and it’s not Florence Nightingale – whilst Su visits ancient Roman town Caerleon and finds time for an amphitheatre showdown with Phil. \r\nAnd Su attempts to resolve an age old mystery...does Phil wear a wig?
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description:
Two stars of the seventies, cool crooner Tony Christie and pop royalty Jimmy Osmond are accompanied by experts Catherine Southon and Margie Cooper. Blasting off from the Leicestershire town of Loughborough they’ll head for an auction in the Staffordshire city of Stoke-on-Trent. 

Tony squeezes in a visit to Coalbrookdale, the place where ground breaking techniques were developed that kick-started the industrial revolution. And petrol-head Jimmy gets to whizz round the historical race circuit at Donington. 

The big auction finale includes a sing-a-long like no other. But which musical maestro will clinch victory?
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: Start by gathering several fascinating facts about Van Gogh’s life, which will then lead you to ask questions that uncover mysteries: What aspects of his life influenced his unique body of work—which is now worth hundreds of millions on the art market—and what ultimately drove him to commit an act of desperation? \r\nDiscover Vincent van Gogh’s early years. From learning French and English to his very first art class, Brabant and its landscapes left an indelible mark on the young Vincent. Discover how Van Gogh made a sudden shift in his path, moving from the ministry and missionary work to a life devoted to art, aided in this by two influential men in his family. You’ll also begin to understand how his difficulties with his parents and scandals involving women would affect him.\r\nWhat is it about the modest Protestant community in Nuenen that inspired Van Gogh to find his artistic voice, and why did he leave behind his extensive body of work when he moved away? This lecture explores how the.
programmes.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story

programmes.description: In many ways, it is in Antwerp that Vincent begins the remarkable evolution that will ultimately make him one of the most important painters in modern art. Explore his journey at the Antwerp Academy, where he slowly sheds the darkness of Hague and begins to play with light and color. \r\nDid you know how much the Impressionist movement in Paris depended on Vincent’s brother, Theo? Find out the truth behind Theo’s enormous influence in promoting and establishing the movement and bringing together the Impressionist artists of the day, with scenes from Jean-Pierre Isbouts’ television drama Manet in Love. \r\nWhat would you do if a difficult relative dropped in without warning and announced they would be living with you from now on? Learn how Theo manages the situation when Vincent arrives in Paris, and revel in the way that Vincent inhales the wonderful new movements of Montmartre. By the 1880s, the Impressionists have slowly begun to drift apart after the deaths of Frédéric Bazille and Édouard.
programmes.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story

programmes.description:
Perhaps the most well-known fact about Vincent’s troubled life is that he cut his ear. Dive into the horrifying story of what it is that inspires him to do something so drastic, and how the people around him respond to the crisis—culminating in the loss of his beloved Yellow House.
Confined to an asylum, Van Goh enters a dark period of illness—yet it is out of this place that he draws inspiration to create his best-known masterpiece, The Starry Night. Listen as Professor Isbouts describes his research on what diagnoses were likely behind Vincent’s “insanity.”
While Vincent is sequestered away at the asylum at Saint-Remy, the art world is moving on. Amazingly, Vincent is gaining growing recognition among art critics, with works shown at an annual exhibition in Brussels. But is Paris ready for him when he returns to meet Theo and Johanna’s newborn baby? 
In this lovely village along the Oise River, Vincent creates what is arguably his most developed and integrated work, including two por.
programmes.title: Van Gogh: The Real Story

programmes.description: Lucas Cranach the Elder (c. 1472-1553) is a major artist of the German Renaissance, working in Wittenberg in the first half of the 16th century. Official painter to Frederic the Wise, the Prince Regent of Saxony, he was close to the reformer Martin Luther. As well as biblical themes, he was above all interested in portrayal of the female nude, as in the “Adam and Eve” of Besancon or the famous “Three Graces”, recently acquired by the Louvre after a fund raising appeal.\r\nEnjoy your visit!
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "The Courtauld Collection: The Party of Impressionism" at the Louis Vuitton Foundation in Paris. We will present some of the masterpieces from the collection of Samuel Courtauld, English industrialist, art collector and founder of the Courtauld Institute of Art and the Courtauld Gallery in London. During this visit you will see works such as "A Bar at the Folies Bergères" by Edouard Manet or "Lake Annecy" by Cézanne.
programmes.title: Private Tour

programmes.description: Edouard Vuillard (1868-1940), find our comments on the works of this founder of the Nabi movement.
programmes.title: Within the frame

programmes.description: At the top of a sloping garden, a mysterious white dome and an undulating glass facade: the House of the French Communist Party, built between 1965 and 1980 by Oscar Niemeyer. A fine example of Jean Prouvé's curtain wall façade, the extraordinary Central Committee room under the dome is one of the finest Parisian buildings of the period.
programmes.title: Architectures

programmes.description: In this episode, we will meet the artist Richard Texier. He is now considered one of the best living artists of his generation. His work is based on the Pantheo Vortex, an artistic exploration of the mystery and beauty of the world. His works can be found in numerous public and private collections, both in France and abroad.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description:
Two favourite Blue Peter presenters Sarah Greene and Peter Duncan are in the company of Natasha Raskin and Catherine Southon as they hunt for antiques around Surrey, Hertfordshire and North West London. 

Peter detours to learn how hockey became a popular sport the world over while keen aviator Sarah sees how the Battle of Britain was won. 

An incredible haul of antiques, including chimney pots, Pinocchio and a pair of African fertility figures, go under the gavel at an auction in Tewkesbury, Gloucestershire.
programmes.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip

programmes.description: In this episode, the candidates Marine and Nicolas will have one hour to walk the streets of Bordeaux under the rain. The imposed theme is: Bordeaux and its inhabitants. They must exceptionally respect an imposed route and take a photograph of the quays.
programmes.title: Photo Contest

programmes.description: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.
programmes.title: Artist's Workshop

programmes.description: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Théodore Géricault. You will discover his labour with An Officer of the Imperial horse guards, Heroic landscape with fisherman or The Horse race.
programmes.title: An hour with...

programmes.description: Take an hour break to discover the work of an Italian painter, Amedeo Modigliani. You will discover his labour with Caryatid, Lolotte or others portraits.
programmes.title: An hour with...

programmes.description: For the fourth day of competition, it's Anouchka, from Rhode-Saint-Genèse, who enters the arena. For as long as she can remember, decorating has been part of the life of this bubbly 45-year-old mum. A few years ago, Anouchka turned to painting and jewellery design. Professions that bring her closer to interior design, her real passion. To prove it she’ll have to stand out from the crowd. And what is our decorator's trademark?
programmes.title: Deco Masters

programmes.description: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Eating flowers might appear unconventional, but we often consume them without even realizing it. Consider artichokes, for instance : they are essentially large, unopened flowers. Capers are the preserved buds of flowers soaked in vinegar, and cloves are dried flower buds. We also find courgette flowers, saffron pistils, orange blossom water used to flavor pastries, and the violet sweets that evoke memories of our childhood. In addition to adding aesthetic appeal and providing a dose of vitamins to our plates, flowers elevate the flavors of a dish and can even serve as a vegetable substitute.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Julie meets us in Bordeaux after having surveyed the Blaye region, visited the Basin twice and travelled through the Libourne region twice, it was necessary to stop in the capital of Bordeaux one day! What better time than September to discover the pearl of Aquitaine, more often called the "City of Wine"? Julie invites the inhabitants to discover the traditions but also the more recent projects of this city full of history and gastronomy.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: We are in the middle of the harvest season, a perfect opportunity to discover the most beautiful French vineyards. Our trip starts with a bit of tourism. We will cross the Drôme with Tain l'Hermitage and its Baume de Venise, but also the Bordeaux region where the different domains compete to attract this new clientele. Then we head for Épernay, capital of the Champagne region, where the reputation of its sparkling wine is well established. Julie will take us to Burgundy, where the most expensive wines in the world are produced, and then back to Bordeaux, to immerse ourselves in the world of high-tech and biodynamic wines.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: It is a mushroom that we are going to focus on today. A mushroom, or a black diamond, some would say: the truffle. And along the way, we will twist the neck of some clichés. \r\nTruffle hunting with dogs, with a sow but also flies... markets and of course cooking to discover or rediscover this mysterious mushroom, in all its aspects, in a salty but also sweet version... Richerenches, Carpentras, Saint Avère, Toulouse, Aix en Provence… the south of France will honor this black diamond!
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Luana Belmondo puts the avocado in the spotlight, a fruit native to Mexico with numerous health benefits. She offers us a recipe for gambas with cucumber and avocado purée, as well as an avocado panna cotta with strawberry salad.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: Impromptu aperitifs aren't always easy. When friends turn up unannounced, stress can quickly mount. Don't panic, Luana Belmondo and Thomas Clouet, a great specialist in the field, improvise an aperitif at the drop of a hat, using very little. Mushroom macaroons, a mini beef tartare and you're ready to go!
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: The Quercy region reveals architectural gems and enchanting landscapes. \r\nRocamadour, a town clinging to its cliffs, Saint-Cirq-Lapopie, a picture-postcard village, and Castelnau-Bretenoux, a fairy-tale fortress, illustrate the richness of a land where tradition and history come together in perfect harmony.
programmes.title: 100 Places to See

programmes.description: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive. On the way, we will stop at the Sourdon family's house to cook sea bream accompanied by an olive fricot. We will then go to Aix en Provence to prepare a strange dessert: the Fernand-style oil pump. Then we head for an exceptional estate, the Villa Beaulieu, to taste a Bagna Cauda like you have rarely seen before finishing with Jean-Luc Rabanel, a starred organic chef and defenders of grand cru olive oil...
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France. Julie will cook a fricassee of berniques, the little Chinese hats that cover the rocks of the coast, as well as pink clams that are little known to the public. We will continue our journey in Finistère to meet Sylvain, the only abalone breeder in the country, and then to Méru where there are still workshops magnifying this sublime material. The Chef Jean-Marie Baudic will cook scallops like no one else.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: In this episode, Luana Belmondo invites her friend Eleonora Galasso for a pizza party! First, they'll make homemade dough. Next, they'll cook a capriciosa with anchovies, capers and ham, and a pizza fritta with oregano and tomato sauce.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: In this episode, Luana Belmondo cooks chickpeas. As they originate from the Middle East, she decides to prepare Lebanese recipes. On the menu: fallafel with chickpeas, kumquat, spices and cinnamon, and chard with chickpeas, parsley, mint and bulgur.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: This week’s heat sees a pair of established designers taking on a less experienced up and coming pair, as they’re challenged to deliver amazing spaces on a budget of £5000, for a community park in Norris Green, Liverpool.  Friends Sue Spout and Dean Bolton-Grant from Harrogate in Yorkshire both own their own garden businesses and between them have decades of experience and include royalty amongst the people they’ve worked for.  Despite living opposite sides of the country Tamara Bridge and Kate Savill have collaborated on a number of show gardens since winning medals for young garden designer of the year.  Faced with designing gardens for an open public area that has in the past been neglected and suffered from vandalism what type of gardens will the designers create?  And who will be victorious?
programmes.title: The Great Garden Challenge

programmes.description: In this week’s episode, professional garden design partners Jon Smith and Adam Woolcott take on Catherine and James Burrage from Yorkshire.  \r\nTheir challenge is to deliver amazing garden spaces on a budget of £5000 for the Knightswood Day Care Centre in the heart of the Essex countryside within sniffing distance of the North Sea.  The centre offers a lifeline to mainly elderly local people who have physical or mental disabilities or who live alone.  With a brief from the centre that includes sensory elements, seating and a potting shed, both teams have ambitious designs but can they complete them in just 2 days?
programmes.title: The Great Garden Challenge

programmes.description: This week’s heat sees professional teams from opposite ends of the UK compete as they’re challenged to create amazing spaces in just 2 days on a budget of £5000, for the Care for Veterans’ care home in Worthing, a specialist care home for elderly and disabled military veterans.  Experienced garden designers and builders, James Hutchison and Stuart Gibson have travelled to the South Coast all the way from London.  While their opponents, Manoj Maldé and Mark Holman, garden designers who collaborate on show gardens together, have only had to travel from Hertfordshire and Kent.  With a brief that includes making sure the gardens are wheelchair friendly and low maintenance the teams come up with very different designs.  James and Stuart are faced with a potentially disastrous problem they aren’t used to dealing with back in Scotland.  But can they resolve it in time and finish their garden?
programmes.title: The Great Garden Challenge

programmes.description: Today, Julie takes us on a tour of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. In the kitchen, they bear witness to our relationship with others, reflecting our vision of the world. Julie's journey will introduce us to the famous black pepper, thanks to Erwann de Kerros, an insatiable pepper seeker. Aromatic plants will also be in the spotlight, as we pick them with Edouard Loubet in the Luberon...
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Today, Julie takes us on a mushroom tour. There is nothing better to occupy your weekends than a walk in the forest in search of edible mushrooms. Some species, such as the cep or the chanterelle, can be preserved very well in the freezer or, for the more patient, in jars. We will also meet two chefs who are passionate about mushrooms and have become specialists in the subject: Franck Quinton and Régis Marcon. But for the moment, we're on the road, discovering typically French dishes with astonishing button mushrooms in Touraine, morels in the Jura, ceps in Gironde, russules charbonnières in Normandy and coulemelles in Auvergne!
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Julie takes to the road in her little red car to honour one of her favourite fruits: the chestnut. Julie will meet several producers in Ardèche, cook the traditional soup of the region with the sparkling Marithé. She will also make the recipe for homemade marrons glacés, before heading to Corsica to work with chestnut flour and the leaves of her tree. This journey will end as always with a clever chef's recipe, and this time it will be Claude Brioude who will do it! This chef likes to shake up the rules and will work the chestnut with fish, two seasonal products that we are not usually used to combining.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Tender and tasty, lamb plays a key role in festive cuisine but also in everyday cuisine. Julie sets off on the French roads to discover the different breeds existing across the country. It must be said that France has one of the most varied productions in the world. There are more than forty breeds listed in 5 categories. But more than the breed, it is the way in which they are fed that interests connoisseurs. Julie introduces us to producers and cooks of this refined dish!
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Wellness cuisine is not synonymous with sadness and insipidity. It can be extremely gourmet, for a balanced way to indulge yourself. On this theme, Luana welcomes young wellness pastry chef Johanna Le Pape. Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: Leftovers often end up in the garbage can. But with a little thought, it's easy to recycle them. This ecological and economical gesture can even delight our taste buds. Like us, Luana Belmondo hates throwing things away. She knows all about waste-free cooking and has mastered the art. She shows us how to reinvent boiled or steamed potatoes as something other than mashed potatoes. On the program: potato soufflé with paprika and vegetable gratin with curry.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: Julie heads for Burgundy to discover ancient breeds of poultry reintroduced to France thanks to the work of breeder Fred Ménager. We'll then move on to Auvergne to discover how the famous Label Rouge is awarded and the role of certifying bodies ... because it's important to know what ends up on our plates. Julie also travels to the Drôme to cook guinea fowl, before heading to the Périgord to prepare a turkey stew. Julie will then head back up towards the center to discover an amazing fly maker who uses rooster feathers!
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Summer is the season when vegetables abound in the garden, but it would be a shame not to savor those that the cooler seasons have to offer: soups, pies, stews or gratins highlight seasonal vegetables, perfect for a nice warm up. To begin this new journey, Julie will cook salsify. This little tour of France will also allow us to meet gardening goldsmiths who sculpt winter vegetables and fruits. Finally, we will conclude as usual with a recipe from a chef, who will go out of his way to create a seasonal recipe for us.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: In this episode, Luana Belmondo puts Normandy in the spotlight! With the region's president, Hervé Morin, she prepares apples poached in cinnamon syrup, as well as mussels... in her own way.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: With her friend Myriam, Luana Belmondo prepares two saffron-based recipes. On the program: orecchiette (small Italian pasta) with sausage, and monkfish with lemon confit and asparagus purée.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description: Water and its beauty, water and its power, water and its fragility... the water we all need is becoming scarce, through our own fault. Some rivers are dry, others are diverted, cut off by dams, others are simply polluted, and this for decades. We will discover how humans transformed the nature in Argentina, then in China and its disproportionate Three Gorges Dam. We will also go in Botswana with the Okavango, this unique river which flows into a desert forming the famous Okavango Delta. Vu du Ciel makes you discover once again another world, magnificent but threatened.
programmes.title: Earth from above

programmes.description: Yann Arthus-Bertrand thus continues his world tour and his inventory of the planet with the great rivers that suffer from man's excesses as a common thread. " So the great rivers may live" is the discovery of places, men and women who are fighting so that our waterways simply have their place on Earth. Thanks to his genius, man is correcting his mistakes: the Aral Sea, which once disappeared, is coming back. In New York, millions of people have drinking water thanks to the natural virtues of the forest.
programmes.title: Earth from above

programmes.description: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.
programmes.title: Earth from above

programmes.description: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive. On the way, we will stop at the Sourdon family's house to cook sea bream accompanied by an olive fricot. We will then go to Aix en Provence to prepare a strange dessert: the Fernand-style oil pump. Then we head for an exceptional estate, the Villa Beaulieu, to taste a Bagna Cauda like you have rarely seen before finishing with Jean-Luc Rabanel, a starred organic chef and defenders of grand cru olive oil...
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Every year, the return of summer is a special moment, heralding the arrival of all those beautiful fruits on the shelves. Whether red, exotic or forgotten, fruit is an essential part of our diet. Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll head to Céret, the cherry capital, and then cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: We headed to the Loir-et-Cher for a hunt supervised by the ONCFS teams. Let's go to the Vosges to cook a tasty deer jig with Mauricette. Let's meet Pierre in the Côte d'Or where he makes hunting horns, an essential tool for hunting. Julie will also meet two hunters from Gironde for a very original afternoon of hunting by the barrel before joining Joël in Aquitaine for another game bird recipe. We will then talk with Laurent about the job of dog trainer. This time it will be Frédéric Robert who will concoct a recipe for hare rubbed with cocoa and cooked in a clay sarcophagus.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: In this episode, Luana welcomes Héloïse Brion, creator of "Miss Maggie's Kitchen," for a unique culinary journey in Normandy. Héloïse, who has French-American roots, offers a clever blend of her American heritage and her life in Normandy. Together, they cook two original recipes: a stuffed squash with apples, inspired by local traditions, and a pecan pie, emblematic of American cuisine.
programmes.title: Luana's Kitchen

programmes.description:
Depression is an illness that will affect more than one in five people during their lifetime. To overcome it, more than 4 million French people take antidepressants, which are essential in certain cases.
For many doctors, treating depression solely with medication has become routine, whether the depression is severe, moderate or mild. This practice is increasingly contested, as antidepressants and anti-anxiety drugs cause numerous side effects and, in some cases, can lead to dependence. They are now viewed with suspicion and mistrust by many patients who are seeking alternative treatments.
Over the past few years, alternative, non-pharmacological methods have emerged to treat depression. Some therapies have even found their way into hospitals.
Studies have, for example, shown that therapies based on mindfulness meditation are just as effective as standard treatments with antidepressants in preventing relapses of depression. Another technique that is rapidly gaining ground is transcrani.
programmes.title: Health Investigation

programmes.description: Paracetamol, ibuprofen or aspirin… Painkillers are everywhere in our medicine cabinets. These treatments are so commonplace that we all too often forget the dangers they pose. First and foremost is paracetamol. Fourteen packets are sold every second in France. Often perceived as harmless, paracetamol is extremely toxic in the event of an overdose. For the 10 million French people who suffer from chronic pain, conventional painkillers are no longer sufficient, and it is often necessary to resort to painkillers derived from morphine and opium. The problem is that these medicines, such as Tramadol, can lead to serious addiction. Over the past ten years, the use of these medicines has risen sharply in France, causing concern amongst health authorities as these painkillers are wreaking havoc in the United States. Every day, 130 Americans die from an opioid-related overdose, which has become the leading cause of preventable death among people under the age of 50, far ahead of road traffic ac.
programmes.title: Health Investigation

programmes.description:
In France, 30 per cent of adults and 50 per cent of older people are affected by high blood pressure. This excessively high blood pressure in the arteries can lead to strokes, heart attacks, kidney failure or dementia.
The World Health Organisation ranks high blood pressure, known as the ‘silent killer’, as the second greatest health risk, just behind smoking. Being overweight, a lack of physical activity, smoking, a diet that is too high in salt and stress are all contributing factors.

More often than not, high blood pressure presents no symptoms, making it difficult to detect. Whilst many patients are unaware that they have high blood pressure, conversely, others are wrongly classified as ‘sick’.

This is because blood pressure fluctuates constantly and can lead to misdiagnosis. A bout of stress or physical exertion can cause blood pressure to rise. Another factor that can skew the reading is the ‘white coat’ effect, linked to the stress of the consultation. In 30 per cent of cases,.
programmes.title: Health Investigation

programmes.description: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Today, Julie takes us down a different kind of yellow-brick road, one that tastes of childhood and gourmet delights: the road of sweets. France may be famous for its gastronomy, but it's not to be outdone when it comes to pastries and confectionery - quite the opposite. “Bêtises” from Cambrai, "Berlingots” from Carpentras, "Calissons” from Aix-en-provence, every region in France has its own sweet or confectionery.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: We will start this journey near La Rochelle to learn a little more about the breeding of the famous bouchot mussels but also a very particular technique to cook them. We will then go on a tour of France's best oysters: towards Cancale, Arcachon, Montpellier and finally Oléron to learn about the different breeding methods and to find out more about all the species in France. Julie will cook a fricassee of berniques, the little Chinese hats that cover the rocks of the coast, as well as pink clams that are little known to the public. We will continue our journey in Finistère to meet Sylvain, the only abalone breeder in the country, and then to Méru where there are still workshops magnifying this sublime material. The Chef Jean-Marie Baudic will cook scallops like no one else.
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Today, Julie sets on the roads of France to talk about an essential product on French tables: cheese. More than a gourmet craze, more than an end-of-meal treat, cheese is associated with French gastronomy, and is also recognized as Intangible Cultural Heritage by UNESCO. With nearly 1,000 varieties (soft cheeses, cooked, blue-veined, pressed cheeses…), the French are the biggest consumers of cheese in the world!
programmes.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook

programmes.description: Recuperarea adevărului istoric ar trebui să devină pentru oricare trăitor onest al acestor meleaguri un obiectiv esenţial al existenţei sale. Criza de identitate cu care se confruntă astăzi poporul român este dovada faptului că falsul istoric al descendenţei noastre, întreţinut de atâta vreme, şi-a atins ţinta. În acelaşi timp, setea de adevăr şi instinctul care îi determină pe foarte mulţi să respingă teoria romanizării Daciei este un semn al puterii de regenerare ce caracterizează acest neam. Dacă până acum ne-au separat atâtea, iată că există ceva care ne poate aduna laolaltă: adevărata noastră identitate, adevăratele noastre rădăcini, demnitatea pe care ne-o dă faptul că suntem descendenţii poporului de nemuritori din Valea Dunării. Traco-geto-dacii aşteaptă să li se facă dreptate, iar emisiunea „Adevăruri tulburătoare” e locul în care lucrurile vor ieşi la lumină!
programmes.title: Adevăruri tulburătoare

programmes.description: O emisiune despre eleganță, stil, sănătate și îngrijire, componentele frumuseții! Octaviana Alexe vă va introduce în lumea glamour și va avea alături, în fiecare sâmbătă, specialiști în estetică, hair-style, make-up, nutriție sau stomatologie, care ne vor prezenta cele mai moderne proceduri, de la clasicele tratamente cosmetice până la cele mai complexe intervenții estetice, modalități de îngrijire sau trucuri de înfrumusețare la îndemnâna oricui. Vom învăța de la stiliști și designeri celebri cum să transformăm o ținută banală într-una spectaculoasă, despre cum ne accesorizăm ținutele în funcție de eveniment sau cum ne creăm un stil vestimentar care să ne definească.
programmes.title: Doza de frumusețe și stil

programmes.description: Viața este ca o scenă deschisă, cu actori de top, care ne-au marcat. Ana Donosa, actriță la Teatrul de Revistă "Constantin Tănase" este gazda unei noi emisiuni de suflet. Vom râde și vom plânge alături de invitații ei, actori consacrați dar și tineri care fac din această pasiune o meserie. Nae Alexandru, Cristian Simion, Adriana Trandafir sau Petru Păun sunt doar câteva dintre numele pe care le-am admirat pe scena de teatru sau în filme, și care ne dezvăluie momente importante din viața lor. programmes.description: Când fulgerul lovește un avion care sosește, pasagerii devin din ce în ce mai nerăbdători, iar inginerii evaluează daunele. Lucrurile se înrăutățesc când mai multe piste sunt închise din cauza vântului puternic. Un avion sosește cu un lichid potențial periculos care se scurge din încărcătură, forțând la carantină personalul de la sol expus acestuia.

programmes.description: Simpla trimitere a oamenilor în spațiu este o misiune extrem de riscantă. Aflați într-o rachetă, astronauții trebuie să supraviețuiască exploziei controlate care lansează nava dincolo de atmosferă și forțelor de frecare înspăimântătoare din timpul reintrării. Este un mediu neiertător, în care erori minore au provocat catastrofe mortale și costisitoare. Pentru a-și pregăti pentru viitor noua capsulă pentru spațiul profund, Orion, inginerii NASA trebuie să analizeze în detaliu fiecare dezastru din trecut. De la exploziile devastatoare ale navetelor spațiale până la tragediile Apollo și Soyuz, eșecurile de ieri reprezintă lecții esențiale. Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.

programmes.title: Ilegal cu Mariana van Zeller

programmes.description: Vom afla de ce în Baltimore o mare parte a străzii s-a prăbușit pe șinele de cale ferată care treceau pe lângă ea. Una dintre cele mai faimoase clădiri din lume - Turnul înclinat din Pisa - era pe punctul de a se prăbuși. Vom vedea dacă specialiștii în inginerie civilă pot salva un zgârie-nori unic din Manhattan și pot face ca un pod pietonal ultramodern să nu mai aibă probleme cu menținerea echilibrului.
programmes.title: Greșeli teribile în inginerie

programmes.description: Tornade în spațiul cosmic, o erupție vulcanică ce produce un boom sonic și o ceață densă ce învăluie Marele Canion și-l face invizibil.

programmes.description: De la experiența îngrozitoare a blackout-ului din Texas în 2020, la șocanta scufundare a Titanicului în 1912, la faimosul ciclon Bhola din 1970 care a luat peste 500.000 de vieți, la catastrofala erupție a vulcanului Krakatoa din 1883 și până la focarul mortal de Ebola din Africa de Vest în 2014, acest episod explorează ce se întâmplă atunci când omenirea nu este pregătită pentru natura dezlănțuită și cum ne putem pregăti mai bine pentru dezastrele de mâine.

programmes.description: Când fulgerul lovește un avion care sosește, pasagerii devin din ce în ce mai nerăbdători, iar inginerii evaluează daunele. Lucrurile se înrăutățesc când mai multe piste sunt închise din cauza vântului puternic. Un avion sosește cu un lichid potențial periculos care se scurge din încărcătură, forțând la carantină personalul de la sol expus acestuia.
programmes.title: Aeroportul din Sydney

programmes.description: Simpla trimitere a oamenilor în spațiu este o misiune extrem de riscantă. Aflați într-o rachetă, astronauții trebuie să supraviețuiască exploziei controlate care lansează nava dincolo de atmosferă și forțelor de frecare înspăimântătoare din timpul reintrării. Este un mediu neiertător, în care erori minore au provocat catastrofe mortale și costisitoare. Pentru a-și pregăti pentru viitor noua capsulă pentru spațiul profund, Orion, inginerii NASA trebuie să analizeze în detaliu fiecare dezastru din trecut. De la exploziile devastatoare ale navetelor spațiale până la tragediile Apollo și Soyuz, eșecurile de ieri reprezintă lecții esențiale. Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.
programmes.title: Lecțiile dezastrului

programmes.description: În Odda se porneşte cea mai abundentă ninsoare pe care au văzut-o şoferii de autocamion Thord Paulsen şi Olav Eike, creând haos pe şosele.
programmes.title: Salvatori pe drumuri înghețate

programmes.description: În Midyat, Turcia, arheologii descoperă vastul oraș subteran Matiate, întins pe tuneluri și încăperi săpate acum mii de ani. Dovezile unor biserici, sinagogi și monede romane sugerează că a fost cândva un refugiu pentru cei care fugeau de persecuții religioase. În Royston, Anglia, muncitorii dau peste o cameră misterioasă săpată în cretă, plină de sculpturi religioase complexe. Sub Orvieto, Italia, săpăturile pentru o pivniță de vin scot la iveală Cavità 254, un impresionant complex subteran etrusc. Cândva carieră sau sistem de apă, umplerea sa intenționată cu ceramică și oase sugerează practici ritualice sau simbolice de înmormântare. În final, în Abarkuh, Iran, arheologii cartografiază o vastă rețea de tuneluri subterane, probabil parte a unui vechi sistem de irigații qanat, exemplu al ingeniozității persane, folosit pentru a supraviețui secetei, războiului și căldurii deșertului.
programmes.title: Lumi ascunse sub orașe

programmes.description: După prăbușirea catastrofală a unei mine din Deșertul Atacama, prinși într-o groapă sufocantă și întunecată, la aproape un kilometru sub pământ, 33 de mineri încep lupta pentru supraviețuire. Sub ochii lumii, într-o cursă contracronometru, se desfășoară o operațiune internațională de salvare, una care a intrat în istorie ca un exemplu de ingeniozitate tehnică, de rezistență și de speranță.
programmes.title: Cursă contracronometru în Chile

programmes.description: Această serie documentară dezvăluie originile celor mai terifiante legende ale omenirii și urmărește modul în care acestea au persistat și au evoluat de-a lungul secolelor.
programmes.title: Monștri

programmes.description: Explorăm trei descoperiri arheologice enigmatice care sfidează orice explicație. În Polonia, oamenii de știință dezgroapă un „mormânt de vampiri” cu un schelet fixat la pământ de o seceră în jurul gâtului. Este aceasta o dovadă a unor fenomene supranaturale sau doar un vestigiu al unor superstiții antice presărate cu frică? În Marea Britanie, o sticlă sigilată de vrăjitoare, umplută cu păr și cuie, dezvăluie latura întunecată a magiei populare antice. În Mexic, cranii care seamănă cu extratereștri provoacă uimire. Este acesta rezultatul unui ritual sau ceva din altă lume?

programmes.description: Vom afla de ce în Baltimore o mare parte a străzii s-a prăbușit pe șinele de cale ferată care treceau pe lângă ea. Una dintre cele mai faimoase clădiri din lume - Turnul înclinat din Pisa - era pe punctul de a se prăbuși. Vom vedea dacă specialiștii în inginerie civilă pot salva un zgârie-nori unic din Manhattan și pot face ca un pod pietonal ultramodern să nu mai aibă probleme cu menținerea echilibrului.

programmes.description: De la experiența îngrozitoare a blackout-ului din Texas în 2020, la șocanta scufundare a Titanicului în 1912, la faimosul ciclon Bhola din 1970 care a luat peste 500.000 de vieți, la catastrofala erupție a vulcanului Krakatoa din 1883 și până la focarul mortal de Ebola din Africa de Vest în 2014, acest episod explorează ce se întâmplă atunci când omenirea nu este pregătită pentru natura dezlănțuită și cum ne putem pregăti mai bine pentru dezastrele de mâine.

programmes.description: Lângă capitala franceză se află trei rețele subterane extraordinare: un sistem de canalizare, cea mai densă rețea de metrou din lume, care transportă 4 milioane de pasageri zilnic și un labirint de cariere care adăpostește cele mai mari catacombe din lume. Metroul, sistemul de canalizare și carierele  sunt trei realizări colosale care simbolizează realizările ingineriei subterane.
programmes.title: Giganți ai ingineriei

programmes.description: Documentarul debutează cu un preview dinamic a a ceea ce urmează să ofere seria – și anume povestea din culise a unei echipe de elită care construiește un sistem de metrou revoluționar, complet automatizat, în valoare de 50 de miliarde de dolari. Este, de departe, cea mai mare și mai avansată linie feroviară nouă inaugurată oriunde pe planetă în 2019. O scenă dramatică, în care personajele principale se confruntă cu o criză, dă startul acțiunii. Membrii echipei își exprimă apoi, într-un montaj de opinii, motivele pentru care acest megaproiect este atât de remarcabil și cum va rivaliza cu cele mai bune sisteme din lume. Amploarea uriașă a lucrărilor care urmează este copleșitoare, lucru evidențiat clar într-o prezentare de ansamblu. O secvență CGI spectaculoasă ne arată ce trebuie realizat: tuneluri apar sub Gara Centrală, îndreptându-se spre nord, traversând un adevărat câmp minat de obstacole subterane și stații noi, înainte de a trece pe sub port și de a continua spre nord-vest. Pe traseu apar stații noi, până la un imens depou de întreținere a trenurilor și un centru de comandă, la Rouse Hill, traversând o zonă inundabilă pe un viaduct numit Skytrain. Din Gara Centrală, alte tuneluri se întind spre sud, străbătând orașul până la Bankstown. O altă linie nouă pornește spre Parramatta, cu o conexiune suplimentară către un aeroport nou. Membrii echipei ne spun cât de conștienți sunt de dimensiunea colosală a sarcinii lor și de faptul că au la dispoziție doar câțiva ani pentru a construi totul.
programmes.title: Metrou inovator

programmes.description: Provincia Guizhou din China, de două ori listată la Nat Geo Best of the World, este din nou în centrul explorărilor în sezonul 2 al programului ”Cele mai frumoase destinații din lume”. După succesul primului sezon, renumitul fotograf și explorator Chris Burkard conduce o călătorie nouă și captivantă prin această provincie. Prin perspectiva sa unică, Chris dezvăluie peisajele uimitoare, cultura bogată și comunitățile vibrante din Guizhou. Combinând peisaje uluitoare, aventură, povești locale și momente deosebite, acest documentar invită spectatorii să descopere spiritul extraordinar și frumusețea atemporală a orașului Guizhou.

programmes.description: Alex Honnold, alpinist de renume mondial, conduce prima expediție în Groenlanda pentru a escalada o stâncă de peste 1.000 de metri înălțime. În primul rând, echipa sa trebuie să traverseze un ghețar imens și să colecteze date științifice valoroase din această îndepărtată parte a lumii. Pe drumul spre vârful ghețarului, echipa va face o ascensiune de 450 de metri pe un perete neescaladat până acum.
programmes.title: Alex Honnold

programmes.description: Forțele aliate planificaseră să cucerească orașul francez Caen în Ziua Z, dar la mai bine de o lună, trupele germane încă se agățau cu încăpățânare de centrul critic, înfrânând 860.000 de soldați ai aliaților pe plaja normandă. Pe 8 iulie, un regiment canadian trebuia să captureze Abbaye d'Ardenne, care străjuia orașul, însă aceasta era controlată de o faimoasă unitate de tancuri, acuzată de oribile crime de război.

Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.

programmes.description: Alex Honnold, alpinist de renume mondial, conduce prima expediție în Groenlanda pentru a escalada o stâncă de peste 1.000 de metri înălțime. În primul rând, echipa sa trebuie să traverseze un ghețar imens și să colecteze date științifice valoroase din această îndepărtată parte a lumii. Pe drumul spre vârful ghețarului, echipa va face o ascensiune de 450 de metri pe un perete neescaladat până acum.

programmes.title: Pompeii

programmes.description: Primele lagăre de pe teritoriul Rusiei au fost înființate în 1918. În încercarea de a scăpa de opozanți, noul regim a trimis mii de cetățeni în locuri îndepărtate.
programmes.title: Gulag

programmes.description: Forțele aliate planificaseră să cucerească orașul francez Caen în Ziua Z, dar la mai bine de o lună, trupele germane încă se agățau cu încăpățânare de centrul critic, înfrânând 860.000 de soldați ai aliaților pe plaja normandă. Pe 8 iulie, un regiment canadian trebuia să captureze Abbaye d'Ardenne, care străjuia orașul, însă aceasta era controlată de o faimoasă unitate de tancuri, acuzată de oribile crime de război.
programmes.title: Ultima bătălie a lui Hitler

programmes.description: În Franța secolului al XVI-lea, astrologul Nostradamus a scris sute de versete criptice care sugerau cunoașterea imposibilă a evenimentelor viitoare, cum ar fi Revoluția Franceză, al Doilea Război Mondial, asasinarea lui JFK și atacurile din 11 septembrie 2001. Cine a fost Nostradamus și ce a spus el? În Europa Centrală, legendele locale spun că celebrul Castel Houska păzește o poartă către iad și este decorul unei povești întunecate și legendare. Aici, tânărul poet Karel Hynek Macha a avut un vis febril despre un viitor care l-a îngrozit. În Italia medievală, Sfântul Francisc de Assisi a fost subiectul primului caz de stigmat din lume, primind rănile mesiei creștin pe mâini, picioare și trunchi. Sunt stigmatele o binecuvântare, un blestem sau un amestec tradițional de legendă și adevăr?
programmes.title: Decodificarea profețiilor istorice

În fiecare episod, jurnalista surprinde o altă piață neagră, de la droguri la arme și comerț cu tigri, cu scopul de a întâlni traficanții, de a afla modul de lucru și a dezvălui circumstanțele și contextul geo-politic care creează o economie subterană de miliarde de dolari.
programmes.title: Ilegal cu Mariana van Zeller

programmes.description: Vom afla de ce în Baltimore o mare parte a străzii s-a prăbușit pe șinele de cale ferată care treceau pe lângă ea. Una dintre cele mai faimoase clădiri din lume - Turnul înclinat din Pisa - era pe punctul de a se prăbuși. Vom vedea dacă specialiștii în inginerie civilă pot salva un zgârie-nori unic din Manhattan și pot face ca un pod pietonal ultramodern să nu mai aibă probleme cu menținerea echilibrului.
programmes.title: Greșeli teribile în inginerie

programmes.description: Tornade în spațiul cosmic, o erupție vulcanică ce produce un boom sonic și o ceață densă ce învăluie Marele Canion și-l face invizibil.

programmes.description: De la experiența îngrozitoare a blackout-ului din Texas în 2020, la șocanta scufundare a Titanicului în 1912, la faimosul ciclon Bhola din 1970 care a luat peste 500.000 de vieți, la catastrofala erupție a vulcanului Krakatoa din 1883 și până la focarul mortal de Ebola din Africa de Vest în 2014, acest episod explorează ce se întâmplă atunci când omenirea nu este pregătită pentru natura dezlănțuită și cum ne putem pregăti mai bine pentru dezastrele de mâine.

Dezvoltarea unor noi costume de supraviețuire, îmbunătățirea sistemelor de evacuare și inovarea unor materiale noi fac călătoria în spațiu mai sigură ca niciodată.
programmes.title: Lecțiile dezastrului

programmes.description: În Odda se porneşte cea mai abundentă ninsoare pe care au văzut-o şoferii de autocamion Thord Paulsen şi Olav Eike, creând haos pe şosele.
programmes.title: Salvatori pe drumuri înghețate

programmes.description: În Midyat, Turcia, arheologii descoperă vastul oraș subteran Matiate, întins pe tuneluri și încăperi săpate acum mii de ani. Dovezile unor biserici, sinagogi și monede romane sugerează că a fost cândva un refugiu pentru cei care fugeau de persecuții religioase. În Royston, Anglia, muncitorii dau peste o cameră misterioasă săpată în cretă, plină de sculpturi religioase complexe. Sub Orvieto, Italia, săpăturile pentru o pivniță de vin scot la iveală Cavità 254, un impresionant complex subteran etrusc. Cândva carieră sau sistem de apă, umplerea sa intenționată cu ceramică și oase sugerează practici ritualice sau simbolice de înmormântare. În final, în Abarkuh, Iran, arheologii cartografiază o vastă rețea de tuneluri subterane, probabil parte a unui vechi sistem de irigații qanat, exemplu al ingeniozității persane, folosit pentru a supraviețui secetei, războiului și căldurii deșertului.
programmes.title: Lumi ascunse sub orașe

programmes.description: După prăbușirea catastrofală a unei mine din Deșertul Atacama, prinși într-o groapă sufocantă și întunecată, la aproape un kilometru sub pământ, 33 de mineri încep lupta pentru supraviețuire. Sub ochii lumii, într-o cursă contracronometru, se desfășoară o operațiune internațională de salvare, una care a intrat în istorie ca un exemplu de ingeniozitate tehnică, de rezistență și de speranță.
programmes.title: Cursă contracronometru în Chile

programmes.description: Această serie documentară dezvăluie originile celor mai terifiante legende ale omenirii și urmărește modul în care acestea au persistat și au evoluat de-a lungul secolelor.
programmes.title: Monștri

programmes.description: Explorăm trei descoperiri arheologice enigmatice care sfidează orice explicație. În Polonia, oamenii de știință dezgroapă un „mormânt de vampiri” cu un schelet fixat la pământ de o seceră în jurul gâtului. Este aceasta o dovadă a unor fenomene supranaturale sau doar un vestigiu al unor superstiții antice presărate cu frică? În Marea Britanie, o sticlă sigilată de vrăjitoare, umplută cu păr și cuie, dezvăluie latura întunecată a magiei populare antice. În Mexic, cranii care seamănă cu extratereștri provoacă uimire. Este acesta rezultatul unui ritual sau ceva din altă lume?
programmes.title: Dovezi îngropate

programmes.description: Serialul Dezastre în aer analizează cauzele care au provocat aceste incidente și dacă ar fi putut fi evitate. programmes.description: Premiata jurnalistă Mariana van Zeller explorează structura și funcționarea celor mai periculoase piețe negre din universul interlop. În fiecare episod, jurnalista surprinde o altă piață neagră, de la droguri la arme și comerț cu tigri, cu scopul de a întâlni traficanții, de a afla modul de lucru și a dezvălui circumstanțele și contextul geo-politic care creează o economie subterană de miliarde de dolari.
programmes.title: Ilegal cu Mariana van Zeller

programmes.description: Vom afla de ce în Baltimore o mare parte a străzii s-a prăbușit pe șinele de cale ferată care treceau pe lângă ea. Una dintre cele mai faimoase clădiri din lume - Turnul înclinat din Pisa - era pe punctul de a se prăbuși. Vom vedea dacă specialiștii în inginerie civilă pot salva un zgârie-nori unic din Manhattan și pot face ca un pod pietonal ultramodern să nu mai aibă probleme cu menținerea echilibrului.
programmes.title: Greșeli teribile în inginerie

programmes.description: Tornade în spațiul cosmic, o erupție vulcanică ce produce un boom sonic și o ceață densă ce învăluie Marele Canion și-l face invizibil.

programmes.description: De la experiența îngrozitoare a blackout-ului din Texas în 2020, la șocanta scufundare a Titanicului în 1912, la faimosul ciclon Bhola din 1970 care a luat peste 500.000 de vieți, la catastrofala erupție a vulcanului Krakatoa din 1883 și până la focarul mortal de Ebola din Africa de Vest în 2014, acest episod explorează ce se întâmplă atunci când omenirea nu este pregătită pentru natura dezlănțuită și cum ne putem pregăti mai bine pentru dezastrele de mâine.

programmes.description: În timpul Marelui Premiu de Formula 1 din Olanda, Gara Centrală din Amsterdam trebuie să gestioneze 60.000 de fani ai curselor. Aceștia pleacă în cursul dimineții, dar se întorc toți în același timp. Pentru Controlul Traficului și angajați, este nevoie de mobilizare totală pentru a gestiona acest flux uriaș de oameni. În timp ce unii încearcă să prevină aglomerația de pasageri, magazinele așteaptă bunurile întârziate.

programmes.description: Lângă capitala franceză se află trei rețele subterane extraordinare: un sistem de canalizare, cea mai densă rețea de metrou din lume, care transportă 4 milioane de pasageri zilnic și un labirint de cariere care adăpostește cele mai mari catacombe din lume. Metroul, sistemul de canalizare și carierele  sunt trei realizări colosale care simbolizează realizările ingineriei subterane.
programmes.title: Giganți ai ingineriei

programmes.description: Documentarul debutează cu un preview dinamic a a ceea ce urmează să ofere seria – și anume povestea din culise a unei echipe de elită care construiește un sistem de metrou revoluționar, complet automatizat, în valoare de 50 de miliarde de dolari. Este, de departe, cea mai mare și mai avansată linie feroviară nouă inaugurată oriunde pe planetă în 2019. O scenă dramatică, în care personajele principale se confruntă cu o criză, dă startul acțiunii. Membrii echipei își exprimă apoi, într-un montaj de opinii, motivele pentru care acest megaproiect este atât de remarcabil și cum va rivaliza cu cele mai bune sisteme din lume. Amploarea uriașă a lucrărilor care urmează este copleșitoare, lucru evidențiat clar într-o prezentare de ansamblu. O secvență CGI spectaculoasă ne arată ce trebuie realizat: tuneluri apar sub Gara Centrală, îndreptându-se spre nord, traversând un adevărat câmp minat de obstacole subterane și stații noi, înainte de a trece pe sub port și de a continua spre nord-vest. Pe traseu apar stații noi, până la un imens depou de întreținere a trenurilor și un centru de comandă, la Rouse Hill, traversând o zonă inundabilă pe un viaduct numit Skytrain. Din Gara Centrală, alte tuneluri se întind spre sud, străbătând orașul până la Bankstown. O altă linie nouă pornește spre Parramatta, cu o conexiune suplimentară către un aeroport nou. Membrii echipei ne spun cât de conștienți sunt de dimensiunea colosală a sarcinii lor și de faptul că au la dispoziție doar câțiva ani pentru a construi totul.
programmes.title: Metrou inovator

programmes.description: Provincia Guizhou din China, de două ori listată la Nat Geo Best of the World, este din nou în centrul explorărilor în sezonul 2 al programului ”Cele mai frumoase destinații din lume”. După succesul primului sezon, renumitul fotograf și explorator Chris Burkard conduce o călătorie nouă și captivantă prin această provincie. Prin perspectiva sa unică, Chris dezvăluie peisajele uimitoare, cultura bogată și comunitățile vibrante din Guizhou. Combinând peisaje uluitoare, aventură, povești locale și momente deosebite, acest documentar invită spectatorii să descopere spiritul extraordinar și frumusețea atemporală a orașului Guizhou.

programmes.description: Alex Honnold, alpinist de renume mondial, conduce prima expediție în Groenlanda pentru a escalada o stâncă de peste 1.000 de metri înălțime. În primul rând, echipa sa trebuie să traverseze un ghețar imens și să colecteze date științifice valoroase din această îndepărtată parte a lumii. Pe drumul spre vârful ghețarului, echipa va face o ascensiune de 450 de metri pe un perete neescaladat până acum.

Pe 8 iulie, un regiment canadian trebuia să captureze Abbaye d'Ardenne, care străjuia orașul, însă aceasta era controlată de o faimoasă unitate de tancuri, acuzată de oribile crime de război.

programmes.description: În Franța secolului al XVI-lea, astrologul Nostradamus a scris sute de versete criptice care sugerau cunoașterea imposibilă a evenimentelor viitoare, cum ar fi Revoluția Franceză, al Doilea Război Mondial, asasinarea lui JFK și atacurile din 11 septembrie 2001. Cine a fost Nostradamus și ce a spus el? În Europa Centrală, legendele locale spun că celebrul Castel Houska păzește o poartă către iad și este decorul unei povești întunecate și legendare. Aici, tânărul poet Karel Hynek Macha a avut un vis febril despre un viitor care l-a îngrozit. În Italia medievală, Sfântul Francisc de Assisi a fost subiectul primului caz de stigmat din lume, primind rănile mesiei creștin pe mâini, picioare și trunchi. Sunt stigmatele o binecuvântare, un blestem sau un amestec tradițional de legendă și adevăr?

programmes.description: În Franța secolului al XVI-lea, astrologul Nostradamus a scris sute de versete criptice care sugerau cunoașterea imposibilă a evenimentelor viitoare, cum ar fi Revoluția Franceză, al Doilea Război Mondial, asasinarea lui JFK și atacurile din 11 septembrie 2001. Cine a fost Nostradamus și ce a spus el? În Europa Centrală, legendele locale spun că celebrul Castel Houska păzește o poartă către iad și este decorul unei povești întunecate și legendare. Aici, tânărul poet Karel Hynek Macha a avut un vis febril despre un viitor care l-a îngrozit. În Italia medievală, Sfântul Francisc de Assisi a fost subiectul primului caz de stigmat din lume, primind rănile mesiei creștin pe mâini, picioare și trunchi. Sunt stigmatele o binecuvântare, un blestem sau un amestec tradițional de legendă și adevăr?
programmes.title: Decodificarea profețiilor istorice

programmes.description: La 1125 de kilometri în largul coastelor ecuadoriene, se ridică la suprafața apei un grup de insule vulcanice unde trăiesc cele mai ciudate viețuitoare ce-au existat vreodată. Formate cu peste 20 de milioane de ani în urmă, insulele au permis vieții să evolueze în izolare, dând naștere unei varietăți surprinzătoare de creaturi, multe dintre ele nemaivăzute în alte locuri pe planetă.
